Anya: Quick heads-up — reproduced a subtle divergence on Zephyr13B-v1.2-int4 when we flip the prefill shard mapping + enable kv_aliasing=true. Divergence shows up around token ~2048 where generation branches.

Anya: Repro command (quick):
```
export MODEL=zephyr13b-v1.2-int4
export PREFILL_MAP=shard-remap-v3
export KV_ALIASING=true
python tests/longctx_repro.py --model $MODEL --seq-len 4096 --seed 42 --prefill-mode warmstart
```

Ben: can you paste minimal log snippet where it diverges?

Anya: sure — truncated log:
```
[step=2039] token=... logits[0]= -1.23
[step=2040] token=... logits[0]= -1.27
[step=2048] token=... logits[0]= -0.11  <-- expected -0.94
checksum(kv_window)= 0x4f2a
checksum(kv_window_after_eviction)= 0x7b9c
```

Carla: Interesting. Is this deterministic across seeds or does it only happen for seed=42?

Anya: deterministic across seeds and boxes as long as warmstart priming is used. Coldstart with no priming doesn't diverge.

Diego: my hunch: aliasing between logical keys and physical slots after the remap + quant rounding. If two keys get same physical index after quantized address calc we might be reading stale slot during prefills.

Ben: could be. Any quick patch to validate? maybe add a guard assert on slot ownership before reading.

Diego: try this env tweak — force stricter alias threshold and disable remap during prefill:
```
KV_ALIAS_THRESHOLD=0.9 python tests/longctx_repro.py ...
PREFILL_MAP=identity python tests/longctx_repro.py ...
```

qa-bot: automated run queued: https://ci.redwood.internal/longctx/1765432199-01 — initial run failed (divergence at 2048). Logs attached.

Ben: can we bisect the remap PR? I remember commit abc1234 changed the remap collision folding.

Carla: adding longanchor-eval run with 5 seeds and diffs -> `./tools/longanchor-eval --model $MODEL --seeds 5 --save-diff` — use that to make a regression card.

Anya: will run both (threshold tweak + longanchor-eval). Also disabling canary for Zephyr13B on Dedicated until we have a fix. @ops can you hold canary on that model? :eyes:

ops: got it, canary paused. filing ticket INF-7543 to track.

Anya: summary after first mitigation: raising KV_ALIAS_THRESHOLD -> reduces divergence frequency but doesn't fully eliminate it. Full repro only when PREFILL_MAP != identity and warmstart priming present. Next step: instrument per-slot epoch counter and add assert on read epoch==write epoch during prefill stitching.

Ben: thanks, keep us posted. If you need GPU time for long runs ping infra.

Anya: will do — uploading artifacts and diffs to the ticket (INF-7543).
